claims.text: The as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 alloy has a uniform, fine lamellar FCC + B2 microstructure.
Annealing AlCoCrFeNi2.1 at approximately 650°C for 1 hour will induce coherent L12 nanoprecipitates within its FCC lamellae.
Light cold rolling will further distribute the L12 nanoprecipitates.
Limiting cold rolling to less than 10% deformation will preserve the fine lamellar spacing.
Final aging at 540–550°C will minimize nanoprecipitate coarsening during subsequent thermal cycling.
The proposed treatment will produce a uniform dispersion of fine, coherent L12 nanoprecipitates in the FCC lamellae of AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
Coherent L12 nanoprecipitates impede dislocation motion through precipitation strengthening.
Dislocation obstruction by the L12 nanoprecipitates increases yield strength.
The L12 nanoprecipitates enhance back stress and work hardening.
The L12 nanoprecipitates stabilize phase boundaries against coarsening.
Stabilization of phase boundaries by L12 nanoprecipitates reduces room-temperature creep.
The nanoprecipitates limit corrosion-initiation sites under cyclic thermal and mechanical loading.
The treatment will increase yield strength by at least 15% relative to untreated AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
The treatment will reduce room-temperature creep rate by 20–30% relative to untreated AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
The treatment will improve fatigue resistance.
The treatment will improve corrosion resistance.
The treatment will maintain good ductility while increasing strength.
The starting AlCoCrFeNi2.1 alloy has inadequate strength and plasticity for extreme-service fasteners.
The starting alloy is susceptible to room-temperature creep and corrosion under cyclic temperature loading.
The intervention is applicable under thermal cycling reaching approximately 600°C.

contradictions.description: The conditions field states that aging at 540–550°C will ensure thermal stability, whereas the uncertainty field says long-term nanoprecipitate stability and mitigation of coarsening still require experimental validation and parameter optimization.
